dedupe_keys.name: re4afagri african land water energy models

description: RE4AFAGRI is an IIASA multi-model workflow for studying renewable energy, agriculture and water needs in rural sub-Saharan Africa. It soft-links standalone models to compare resource deficits and technology choices, including irrigation and energy-supply scenarios. Users provide geospatial land and water data, crop demand, energy technologies and planning assumptions; outputs are mapped needs or optimised options for the selected region and period. Geographic coverage is African case areas specified by inputs. The README displays GPL-3.0 terms, describes the components and gives setup guidance. It also lists GAMS with an active CPLEX licence as a dependency for part of the workflow, which may require payment beyond the free source. A limitation is that soft-linked models can carry inconsistent resolutions and uncertainty from their component datasets. RE4AFAGRI can assess off-grid power and irrigation infrastructure options. The related catalogue OSeMOSYS model is a separate energy optimiser. No GAMS licence, dataset or package was obtained.
